rationale: The workflow already implements the main applicable evidence-supported optimization: dependency caching is in place for Flutter (subosito/flutter-action with cache: true) and Rust (Swatinem/rust-cache@v2), matching P-LIT-GHA-CACHE. The only other workflow-level candidate, P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (concurrency cancel-in-progress), is contraindicated because this workflow performs conditional TestFlight deployment/upload work, which the evidence lists as a contraindication for cancelling superseded runs. The job already has an explicit timeout (60 minutes), but ci_history shows no completed runs, so there is no representative history to derive a tighter custom timeout per P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT. Matrix, schedule, test-selection, test-prioritization, and Bazel patterns do not apply: there is a single job, no schedule, no test step, and no Bazel build. No safe, evidence-supported change preserves the intended build and TestFlight coverage while improving CI efficiency.
